name: caidera
description: Compliance checks for marketing material. Upload a document and an AI Reviewer checks it against the rules of your markets.

interface.longDescription:
Caidera checks marketing material for regulatory compliance, right from your chat.

Attach a PDF or image to the chat, or pick a document already in your Caidera workspace. Caidera proposes the markets, product type and audience; you confirm them. You then choose one of your workspace's AI Reviewers, for example a reviewer for German healthcare-professional advertising of prescription drugs, and Caidera checks the document against the rules of the selected markets.

After a few minutes you get the findings in the chat: each issue with its severity, the quoted passage, an explanation and a suggested fix. The full report stays in your Caidera workspace, where your team can review and work on it.

Supported markets: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, France, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Belgium, Sweden and the United Kingdom. Product types: prescription and OTC drugs, medical devices, food supplements and cosmetics. Audiences: healthcare professionals and the general public.

Requires a Caidera workspace with the ChatGPT connector enabled. You sign in with your Caidera account; Caidera only accesses the workspace you pick during sign-in.
capabilities: Upload a document attached in the chat to your Caidera workspace
Find documents already uploaded to your Caidera workspace
Set the markets, product type and audience a document is checked for
List the AI Reviewers that fit a document
Run an AI Reviewer compliance check and show its findings
defaultPrompt: Check this flyer for compliance in Germany
Which of my Caidera documents can I check?
Check a document from my Caidera workspace

positive.description: Upload a PDF attached in the chat and run a compliance check end to end
positive.prompt: Check the attached brochure for compliance. It advertises a prescription drug to doctors in Germany.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the attached file, confirms Germany / prescription drug / healthcare professionals with the user, saves the scope, lists the matching AI Reviewers, starts the one the user picks and, once finished, shows the findings with severity, quoted passage, explanation and suggested fix for each.

positive.description: Find an existing document by its title
positive.prompt: Find my Caidera document called Spring Campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching uploaded documents from the user's workspace with title and id, or says that none match.

positive.description: Check a document that is already in the workspace
positive.prompt: Run a compliance check on my Spring Campaign document for Austria and Switzerland. It is for the general public and promotes an OTC drug.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the document, confirms markets, product type and audience, saves them, lets the user pick a reviewer and starts the check, returning a run the user can follow up on.

positive.description: List the AI Reviewers that fit a document
positive.prompt: Which Caidera reviewers can check my Spring Campaign document?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewers that apply to the document's saved scope, and names reviewers that do not apply together with the reason.

positive.description: Upload an attached file as a new version of an existing document
positive.prompt: The attached PDF is the updated version of my Spring Campaign document. Upload it to Caidera as a new version.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Spring Campaign document, confirms it with the user, and uploads the attached file as a new version of it (not as a new document), reporting the document id and new version number.

negative.description: General medical question, not a document check. Caidera should not be called; ChatGPT answers from its own knowledge or suggests asking a healthcare professional.
negative.prompt: What is the usual dose of ibuprofen for adults?

negative.description: Writing new marketing copy. Caidera only checks existing documents, so no Caidera tool should run; ChatGPT may write the text itself and can offer to check it with Caidera once it is saved as a document.
negative.prompt: Write me a social media post for our new allergy spray.

negative.description: Unrelated request. No Caidera tool should run; ChatGPT answers without the plugin.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Berlin tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: upload a document from the chat or pick one from your Caidera workspace, set markets, product type and audience, run an AI Reviewer and read the findings in ChatGPT.
